checks.evidence: Run node qa/verify-freeze.mjs. This checks repository HEAD/clean status and profile configuration hashes, not every runtime data file.
Independently build with CGO_ENABLED=0 and launch the compiled application. Record exact commands and exit codes.

Distinct client identity connects through existing Remote protocol; enumerate authorized Hosts, workspaces and actual history without sending a model prompt or modifying existing tasks. Credential values must not enter logs.
Session snapshots, cursor/gap handling, assistant revisions, cancellation and disconnect are exercised. Label fixture coverage separately from real Host observations.
Fixture tests assert actual outgoing session/prompt, cancel, $events and $events/result protocol fields. No real approval, interruption or paid model prompt is authorized for smoke testing.
Runtime process inventory verifies no full local dsh runtime and no permanent hidden WebView holding the transport. Record helper dependencies and bundle size.

Actual normal/forced connected screens and isolated synthetic structured replay recorded in qa/parity-gui-round9.json. Independent input popup/arrow/pointer/blur behavior passed, but native forced-dark sidebar/input backing mismatch failed. No complete parity,15.8 or M1 claim.

Verify 1.5 second rotation plus breathing arc and shared phase with time-controlled samples or screen recording; verify no per-frame business state mutation and no animation scheduler after all indicators disappear.
Opening and closing a compatibility page creates/destroys it while remote connection survives. Closing the window terminates only this app's owned helper.

Needs the user's M1 MacBook Air. Use the same remote session, viewport, animation count and event replay. Include helper and attributable WebKit processes; measure default-animation official and reduced-motion baselines independently. M4 development tests do not satisfy this gate.
